system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 1 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 4 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (1): Awaken the House Spirit
  • Intermediate (2): Conjure Greater Demon, Conjure Lesser Demon
  • Advanced (4): Create Vozhd, Dracul, Lord of the Land, The Inmost Tug

Base rating-tracker for the Koldunic Sorcery Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
